For your stir-fry, a good alternative to soy sauce that maintains the savory, umami flavor profile is coconut aminos. It is made from the sap of coconut blossoms and salt, making it soy-free and gluten-free. It has a slightly sweeter and milder taste than soy sauce, so you may want to add a splash of vinegar or a pinch of salt to balance the flavor if needed. Another option is tamari, but please verify that the specific brand is certified soy-free, as traditional tamari is made from soybeans.
